text:
Exercise Objective: Develop strength and range of motion of the hips

## Procedure

1. Begin with feet shoulder-width apart with knees and hips slightly flexed
2. Take a large step to the left, keeping both feet facing forward
3. Push hips back, shift weight onto left leg, and flex left knee and hip (right leg remains straight) (-10a)
4. Hold position for 3 s

5. Stand up through left leg by keeping weight on left leg and brining right leg back to shoulder-width
6. Lower into a squat, keeping weight on heels (-10b)
7. Return to start position

## Coaching Points

- When shifting weight onto left leg, the knee should remain directly above the ankle
- Keep right foot flat on the ground while shifting weight to left leg
